profile.headline: Software Developer at Howard Fertilizer and Chemical | CS @ UCF Alum ‘23
profile.summary: Hi! My name is Nicole and I am a graduate from the University of Central Florida with a bachelor's degree in computer science. Since I was young, I have always been interested in tech and that passion has followed me into my career and my personal life. I am most passionate about web development and game design. If you want to check out my portfolio website with more of my projects and skills check it out here: https://nicoleestelle.com

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Develop web applications using .NET, C#, Javascript, HTML, and CSS
- Publish and maintain web applications using Azure Portal and Azure DevOps
- Develop and maintain Tableau dashboards using custom SQL queries
- Solve HelpDesk tickets involving web applications and Tableau dashboards
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Infrastructure and +3 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Develop web applications using .NET and Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio utilizing libraries like LINQ, and designing/implementing responsive user interfaces
- Web Development using HTML, CSS, and Javascript
- Develop 2D, 3D, and VR applications using Unity and Unreal Engine
- Scripting in C# for application development and management in Unity
- Support daily technological operations and development for VR environments and websites running WordPress and .NET. 
- Work with technical leads to support web and VR application development, updates, and maintenance. 
- Provide first point of contact for application support and resolution.

positions.title: Operations Manual Branding Corrections
positions.description:
Micro Internship for Oelrich Construction, Inc. 

- Branding Enhancement: Worked meticulously on editing and refining design documents using Adobe InDesign to maintain a uniform and visually appealing company branding throughout our operations manuals.
- Document Precision: Ensured the accuracy, completeness, and technical integrity of documents, making them easily comprehensible for a diverse audience.
- Client Collaboration: Maintained open and transparent communication with clients, actively engaging with them to discuss progress, address concerns, and incorporate any desired changes.
- Quality Assurance: Conducted thorough reviews and design of content, graphics, and layouts, striving for excellence in the document.
positions.insights: Adobe InDesign, Graphic Design and +1 skill

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description:
- Prototyped with Figma and developed utilizing React.js and CSS, fully displaying my achievements and skills in a responsive website with attractive-looking UI reflecting my personality and skillset. 
- Hosted using Netlify and used GitHub for source control.
- Continuing to update the site as I learn more fun things in React and CSS :-)

projects.title: GAEA Pulse Feedback Mobile and Web App – U.S. Space Force
projects.description:
- Lead the front-end mobile development in the creation of the mobile survey application for the U.S. Space Force as well as assisted in the web front-end development process.
- Utilized wireframing/protoyping techniques with Figma
- Designed logo for project in Figma through an iterative design process
- Developed in Javascript with React Native, ExpoGo, and MudBlazor. 
- Project for Senior Design capstone at the University of Central Florida.
